handwritten_policy: Exact supported plain metaclasses only; canonical ownership required; typed explicit library bindings; exclude self-default; explicit contributions precede computed defaults. remaining_dependencies: Automatic bindings cover canonical standard-library roots already in the closed graph. External/global resource loading remains unimplemented.
